name: the-good-bits
description: The Good Bits: browser-based auto sample chopper, loop conformer and loop remixer. Silence/phrase detection for melodic sources, tempo-locked loop chopping and one-shot extraction for drums, auto key/tempo detection, PLAY NICE - conform unrelated loops to a shared tempo and key - and FLIP, which takes one loop and proposes batches of automatic remixes of it. Static site, deploy as-is to GitHub Pages.
